raw_excerpt: The Standard Purchase Price is $108,000.00 dollars. The Standard Purchase Price includes an initial franchise license fee of $44,000.00 dollars and a standard Equipment and Products Package costing $64,000.00 dollars. The minimum initial franchise fee is $44,000.00 dollars.
